newsitem.title: USA: MFRI Q4 Jan 31 net a record on margin gain.
newsitem.headline: MFRI Q4 Jan 31 net a record on margin gain.

text.p: MFRI Inc said Tuesday higher gross profit margins helped earnings in the fourth quarter ended January 31 reach a new record.

The company, which makes filters for industrial air pollution systems and designs specialty piping systems, said net income reached $512,000, or $0.11 a share, compared with $395,000, or $0.09, a year ago.
Sales in the period rose to $23.3 million from $20.1 million, MFRI said.

Prospects for continued strong performances by two of its units, along with the recently acquired Thermal Care business, are encouraging signs that fiscal 1998 will be a year of continued gains, the company said.
MFRI shares were off 1/8 Tuesday at 7-3/8.
